title: Backups
description: Centralize settings transfer, manual sidecar backup, and the current logical database backup workflow in one place.

status.notice: Status shows the last known action for each backup surface available to your account.

appSettings.title: App Settings
appSettings.description: Export or import BookLore application settings.

sidecar.title: Sidecar
sidecar.description: Manual sidecar backup for a selected library.

database.title: Database
database.description: Logical database backup and restore preparation.

appSettings.description: Reuse the live application settings export and import flow here so backup activity stays in the dedicated Backups area.

sidecar.notice: Automatic sidecar writes stay in Metadata settings. This tab only keeps the manual per-library backup routine.

databaseExport.title: Logical Database Backup
databaseExport.description: BookLore does not run database backup inside the app yet. This helper generates the supported MariaDB export command from the current docs.
databaseExport.warning: A full recovery still requires both the SQL dump and copies of your media files and app data directory.

databaseRestore.title: Logical Database Restore
databaseRestore.description: Use the current documented restore flow for an existing schema. Pre-flight stays blocked until the required operator checks are confirmed.
databaseRestore.warning: Restore to a new temporary schema is not supported with the current database grants. Restore only into the existing booklore schema.
databaseRestore.missingSqlPath: Select the SQL dump that will be restored.
databaseRestore.missingAppDataPath: Enter the mounted BookLore app-data path.
databaseRestore.missingComposePath: Enter the compose or deployment config path.
databaseRestore.preflightPassedDetail: All required restore checks passed. The restore command can now be copied.
databaseRestore.preflightBlockedDetail: Resolve the failed checks before using the restore command.
